original.description: Portrait of General Maurice Sarrail, from a Bain News Service negative.
original.photographer: not named on the negative; published by Bain News Service
original.date: not established in the record ("Unknown date"); Bain’s French general portraits are of the war years
original.archive: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; Permission "PD-US"). The Bain collection at the Library of Congress carries no known restrictions.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — French general officer’s uniform, documented; but the undated original means the caption must not tie the likeness to a month.

caption: General Maurice Sarrail, who took over the French Third Army from Ruffey on 30 August 1914 and held its right on Verdun through the Marne.
credit: Original photograph: Bain News Service; Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. The archive gives no date — the caption dates the command, not the photograph.
